title: HostFormSourceViewDocument
description: Server-maintained manager read view of one native form's share-link funnel, at hostFormSourceViews/{formId}: each link's label, opens, starts and submissions, exactly the sources getOrganizerFormAnalytics returns (at most 200 links). Written by triggers on organizerFormShareLinks and organizerForms; absent while the form has no links. Never a link token, and never identity, permission or mutation authority.
x-owner: Host read model projector (hostReadModels form view triggers)
